📰 General

SFO and Oakland Reach Settlement Over Airport Name Dispute •

San Francisco International Airport (SFO) and Oakland International Airport will retain the Oakland San Francisco Bay Airport name following a settlement announced by the San Francisco City Attorney’s Office. The lawsuit, initiated by San Francisco officials, centered around the airport’s branding and trademark usage. The settlement avoids further legal action and preserves the existing naming convention. The agreement reflects a resolution to the intercity dispute regarding the airport’s identity.

🌍 World

IDF Destroys Two Massive Hezbollah Tunnels with Iranian Direction in Lebanon •

The Israel Defense Forces (IDF) successfully identified and neutralized two significant Hezbollah attack tunnels in the town of Qantara, southern Lebanon. The operation was facilitated by intelligence indicating the tunnels were built with explicit guidance from Iran. According to the IDF, the tunnels were substantial in size and posed a serious threat to Israeli security. This marks a continued escalation in the ongoing conflict between Israel and Hezbollah, highlighting Iran’s active role in bolstering the group’s capabilities.

🦅 US

Antarctic Ice Melt Accelerating as Ocean Heat Fuels Dramatic Retreat •

A new study indicates that rising ocean temperatures are causing significant melting of Antarctic ice shelves from below. Researchers found that warmer water is eroding the underside of these ice shelves at an accelerated rate. This process threatens to destabilize the entire ice sheet and contribute to rising sea levels worldwide. The melting is linked to broader climate change impacts, including potential disruptions to global weather patterns.

💰 Business

Baby Born on Delta Flight: Paramedics Assist Delivery Just Before Landing •

A passenger aboard a Delta Air Lines flight departing from Atlanta experienced a sudden delivery of a healthy baby girl. Paramedics were immediately on hand to assist the passenger just moments before the Boeing 737 was scheduled to land. The newborn girl weighed approximately 5.5 pounds and was reportedly in good condition. Flight attendants alerted medical personnel, ensuring the passenger received prompt care and attention.

💻 Technology

YouTube TV Introduces Customizable Multiview, Allowing Users to Watch Multiple Channels Simultaneously •

YouTube TV has launched a new feature enabling subscribers to view up to four channels concurrently on a single screen. The customizable multiview functionality allows users to select channels from the platform’s extensive lineup. This feature was developed over several years and represents a significant expansion of YouTube TV’s viewing options. The rollout is being implemented across the platform’s subscriber base, offering a more dynamic viewing experience.

🎭 Entertainment

Zendaya Dominates Met Gala, Showcasing Stunning Custom Valentino Gown •

Zendaya graced the 2024 Met Gala with a breathtaking custom Valentino Haute Couture gown designed by Pierpaolo Piccioli. The dress featured a dramatic, floor-length silhouette with intricate embellishments and a deep V-neckline. She accessorized with Tiffany & Co. jewelry and a stunning diamond bracelet. The event celebrated “The Garden of Time” theme, and Zendaya’s appearance was widely considered a standout moment.

🏅 Sports

Ravens Secure Veteran QB Diego Pavia with Three-Year Contract, Skipping Minicamp •

Baltimore Ravens have signed quarterback Diego Pavia as an undrafted free agent. Pavia initially accepted an invitation to the rookie minicamp but instead opted for a three-year contract agreement with the team. The deal bypasses the standard minicamp tryout process for new acquisitions. Pavia joins the Ravens roster following a successful career as a college football player.

🔬 Science

Artemis 3 SLS Rocket’s Core Stage Successfully Delivered to Florida Launch Site •

NASA’s Space Launch System (SLS) rocket’s core stage, crucial for the Artemis 3 mission, has been transported to Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The top 80% of the stage arrived on Monday, marking a significant step in preparations for the crewed lunar landing. This delivery signifies the ongoing construction and readiness for the planned 2027 launch date. The core stage is a vital component of the Artemis 3 spacecraft.

🩺 Health

Stubborn Belly Fat Linked to Liver Damage: 5 Daily Habits to Avoid •

Research indicates that visceral fat, commonly known as stubborn belly fat, poses a significant risk to liver health. This type of fat, which accumulates around internal organs like the liver, is more damaging than subcutaneous fat. The article details five daily habits that contribute to the buildup of visceral fat and subsequently, liver stress. These include excessive alcohol consumption, a diet high in processed foods, lack of physical activity, and chronic stress. Experts recommend mitigating these habits to protect liver function.
